{{Top|leg}}
The '''Revos-Scohar railway''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] rail passage from the entertainment-complex city [[Revos]] to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Scohar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

It was considered to be an [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] and public relations marvel. It was made up of a series of repulsorlift cars attached together that traveled along a featureless tunnel. It would periodically rise into open air, allowing the passengers to view the planet's snowcapped mountain peaks.<ref name="WS" />
